nodes.name: mcp-types package
nodes.summary: The standalone mcp-types distribution: wire protocol models, JSON-RPC envelopes, versioned surface types, and the method registry.
nodes.detail: mcp-types is a minimal package (pydantic + typing-extensions only) that can be installed independently of the full SDK. It publishes the version-superset model set in mcp_types._types, two generated per-revision surface packages (_v2025_11_25, _v2026_07_28), the JSON-RPC envelope types, the method registry with its parse/serialize functions, and the protocol-version registry. The mcp package re-exports every public name from here via mcp.types.

nodes.name: mcp.types shim
nodes.summary: Four thin re-export modules under src/mcp/types/ that mirror mcp_types under the mcp.types namespace for v1 compatibility.
nodes.detail: Each module does only one thing: `from mcp_types.<sub> import *` and re-exports __all__. This keeps v1-style `from mcp.types import Tool` working while the canonical source of truth is mcp_types. No logic lives here.

nodes.name: Wire type definitions
nodes.summary: Version-superset Model Context Protocol (MCP) wire types as Pydantic models: every field from every supported protocol version in one file.
nodes.detail: Defines MCPModel (camelCase alias base), all request/result/notification classes, capability structs, and content blocks. Carries fields from all supported revisions so application code uses one type regardless of negotiated version. Per-field docstrings note which version introduced or removed each field. The _v* surface packages hold schema-exact wire shapes for strict validation; this file holds the app-facing union. Forward references to InputResponses are rebuilt at module bottom via model_rebuild(). Union types (ClientRequest, ServerRequest, etc.) and their TypeAdapters are assembled at the bottom of the file.
facts: EmptyResult dumps as {} (result_type defaults to None)
InputRequiredResult validator requires at least one of input_requests or request_state

nodes.name: MCPModel
nodes.summary: Base Pydantic model for all MCP protocol types; enables camelCase alias generation.
nodes.detail: Sets alias_generator=to_camel and populate_by_name=True in its ConfigDict so all subclasses serialize with camelCase field names on the wire while Python code uses snake_case. All protocol models in this file inherit from this class (or from BaseModel for JSON-RPC envelopes).

nodes.name: Request
nodes.summary: Generic base for JSON-RPC request payloads (without the envelope id/jsonrpc fields).
nodes.detail: Generic over RequestParamsT and MethodT. The JSON-RPC envelope is attached by the session layer, not here. Declares a ClassVar name_param used by SEP-2663 to inject the Mcp-Name header for tasks/* requests. Concrete subclasses set method as a Literal and params with the specific Params type.
nodes.code:
class Request(MCPModel, Generic[RequestParamsT, MethodT]):
    method: MethodT
    params: RequestParamsT
    name_param: ClassVar[str | None] = None

nodes.name: Result
nodes.summary: Base for all JSON-RPC result payloads; carries the optional _meta field.
nodes.code:
class Result(MCPModel):
    meta: Meta | None = Field(alias="_meta", default=None)

nodes.name: Notification
nodes.summary: Generic base for JSON-RPC notification payloads (no id; no response expected).

nodes.name: CacheableResult
nodes.summary: Base for results that carry client-side caching directives (2026-07-28); holds ttl_ms and cache_scope.

nodes.name: InputRequiredResult
nodes.summary: Signals the server needs client input before completing a request (2026-07-28); replaces the standalone JSON-RPC round-trip.
nodes.detail: result_type is Literal 'input_required'. A model_validator enforces that at least one of input_requests or request_state is present. The client retries the original request with the fulfilled responses and the echoed request_state.

nodes.name: InitializeRequest
nodes.summary: Client-to-server handshake request (protocol versions up to 2025-11-25; removed in 2026-07-28).

nodes.name: InitializeResult
nodes.summary: Server's handshake response carrying the negotiated protocol version, capabilities, and optional instructions.

nodes.name: DiscoverRequest
nodes.summary: Asks the server to advertise its supported protocol versions and capabilities (2026-07-28); replaces the initialize handshake.

nodes.name: DiscoverResult
nodes.summary: Server's response to server/discover; extends CacheableResult with supported_versions, capabilities, and instructions.

nodes.name: Tool
nodes.summary: Definition for a callable tool: name, description, input_schema (JSON Schema), optional output_schema, and display hints.
nodes.code:
class Tool(BaseMetadata):
    description: str | None = None
    input_schema: dict[str, Any]
    execution: ToolExecution | None = None
    output_schema: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    icons: list[Icon] | None = None
    annotations: ToolAnnotations | None = None
    meta: Meta | None = Field(alias="_meta", default=None)

nodes.name: CallToolRequest
nodes.summary: Client request to invoke a named tool with optional arguments and optional task metadata.

nodes.name: CallToolResult
nodes.summary: Server's response to a tool call: a list of ContentBlock values, optional structured_content, and an is_error flag.
nodes.detail: Tool-level errors are reported via is_error=True inside the result, not as JSON-RPC protocol errors, so the LLM can self-correct. Protocol-level errors (tool not found, etc.) are JSON-RPC errors.

nodes.name: Resource
nodes.summary: A named resource the server can read, with URI, optional MIME type, size hint, and display icons.

nodes.name: ReadResourceRequest
nodes.summary: Client request to read a resource by URI; can carry input responses for multi-round-trip flows (2026-07-28).

nodes.name: ReadResourceResult
nodes.summary: Server's response to resources/read; carries a list of TextResourceContents or BlobResourceContents.

nodes.name: Prompt
nodes.summary: A prompt template the server offers, with optional arguments list and icons.

nodes.name: GetPromptResult
nodes.summary: Server's response to prompts/get; contains a list of PromptMessage objects.

nodes.name: ClientCapabilities
nodes.summary: Capability flags a client declares: sampling, elicitation, roots, tasks, and extension maps.
nodes.detail: extra='allow' so unrecognized capability keys round-trip. Sent once at initialize through 2025-11-25; sent per-request via _meta on 2026-07-28.

nodes.name: ServerCapabilities
nodes.summary: Capability flags a server declares: logging, prompts, resources, tools, completions, extensions, tasks.

nodes.name: TextContent
nodes.summary: A plain-text content block with type discriminator 'text'; used in tool results, prompt messages, and sampling.

nodes.name: ImageContent
nodes.summary: A base64-encoded image content block with MIME type; type discriminator 'image'.

nodes.name: AudioContent
nodes.summary: A base64-encoded audio content block with MIME type; type discriminator 'audio'.

nodes.name: EmbeddedResource
nodes.summary: A resource embedded inline in a prompt or tool result; type discriminator 'resource'.

nodes.name: ContentBlock
nodes.summary: Union alias for content blocks in prompts and tool results: TextContent | ImageContent | AudioContent | ResourceLink | EmbeddedResource.

nodes.name: ClientRequest
nodes.summary: Union of all client-to-server request payloads across supported protocol versions; used as the dispatch target.
nodes.code:
ClientRequest = (
    PingRequest | InitializeRequest | CompleteRequest
    | SetLevelRequest | GetPromptRequest | ListPromptsRequest
    | ListResourcesRequest | ListResourceTemplatesRequest
    | ReadResourceRequest | SubscribeRequest | UnsubscribeRequest
    | CallToolRequest | ListToolsRequest
    | DiscoverRequest | SubscriptionsListenRequest
)
client_request_adapter = TypeAdapter[ClientRequest](ClientRequest)

nodes.name: ServerResult
nodes.summary: Union of all server result payloads; InputRequiredResult is last because its optional fields would shadow other members in left-to-right union resolution.

nodes.name: ClientNotification
nodes.summary: Union of client-to-server notifications: CancelledNotification, ProgressNotification, InitializedNotification, RootsListChangedNotification.

nodes.name: ServerNotification
nodes.summary: Union of server-to-client notifications across all supported versions.

nodes.name: ElicitRequest
nodes.summary: Server request to elicit information from the user via the client; params are either form-mode or URL-mode.

nodes.name: CreateMessageRequest
nodes.summary: Server request to sample an LLM via the client (sampling/createMessage); deprecated in 2026-07-28.

nodes.name: SubscriptionsListenRequest
nodes.summary: Opens a long-lived subscription channel for receiving server notifications outside any specific request (2026-07-28).

nodes.name: SamplingMessage
nodes.summary: A message in a sampling conversation (role + content block or list); content_as_list normalizes the union.

nodes.name: RequestParamsMeta
nodes.summary: TypedDict for the _meta field on request params; open-map (extra_items=Any) holding the optional progress token and reserved io.modelcontextprotocol/* keys.

nodes.name: BaseMetadata
nodes.summary: Base for entities with a programmatic name and an optional human-readable title (Tool, Resource, Prompt, etc.).

nodes.name: ToolAnnotations
nodes.summary: Hint properties for a tool: title, read_only_hint, destructive_hint, idempotent_hint, open_world_hint; all hints, not guarantees.

nodes.name: ListToolsResult
nodes.summary: Paginated, cacheable list of Tool definitions; extends both PaginatedResult and CacheableResult.

nodes.name: ProgressNotification
nodes.summary: Out-of-band notification of progress for a long-running request, keyed by progress token.

nodes.name: CancelledNotification
nodes.summary: Either-side notification cancelling a previously-issued in-flight request by its id.

nodes.name: Implementation
nodes.summary: Identifies an MCP client or server implementation by name, version, description, URL, and icons; sent in clientInfo/serverInfo.

nodes.name: JSON-RPC envelope types
nodes.summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope models (JSONRPCRequest, JSONRPCResponse, JSONRPCError, JSONRPCNotification) and all protocol error codes.
nodes.detail: Defines the four message envelope classes and the jsonrpc_message_adapter TypeAdapter used to decode any incoming wire frame. Error code constants cover the standard JSON-RPC range (-32700 to -32603) plus MCP server-error range (-32000 to -32099): SDK-internal codes (-32000, -32001), MCP spec codes (-32020 to -32022, -32042). The module docstring references https://www.jsonrpc.org/specification.

nodes.name: JSONRPCRequest
nodes.summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 request envelope with jsonrpc, id, method, and optional params dict.

nodes.name: JSONRPCResponse
nodes.summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 success response envelope; result field is a raw dict passed to the type-specific decoder.

nodes.name: JSONRPCError
nodes.summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 error response envelope; id is nullable (None encodes null when the id could not be determined).

nodes.name: JSONRPCNotification
nodes.summary: JSON-RPC 2.0 notification envelope (no id field; no response expected).

nodes.name: jsonrpc_message_adapter
nodes.summary: TypeAdapter for the JSONRPCMessage union; the entry point for decoding any inbound wire frame.
nodes.code:
JSONRPCMessage = JSONRPCRequest | JSONRPCNotification | JSONRPCResponse | JSONRPCError
jsonrpc_message_adapter: TypeAdapter[JSONRPCMessage] = TypeAdapter(JSONRPCMessage)

nodes.name: Method registry
nodes.summary: Per-version method maps (surface maps) and version-free method maps (monolith maps), plus two-step parse and serialize functions for every message direction.
nodes.detail: CLIENT_REQUESTS, CLIENT_NOTIFICATIONS, SERVER_REQUESTS, SERVER_NOTIFICATIONS, SERVER_RESULTS, and CLIENT_RESULTS are MappingProxyType dicts keyed by (method, version) pointing to the per-revision surface class. MONOLITH_REQUESTS, MONOLITH_NOTIFICATIONS, and MONOLITH_RESULTS map method strings to the version-free mcp_types models. The parse_* functions first validate against the surface (catching version-gated methods and shape errors), then parse into the monolith model. serialize_server_result uses the surface to strip fields unknown to the negotiated version via extra='ignore'. CACHEABLE_METHODS and INPUT_REQUIRED_METHODS are derived from MONOLITH_RESULTS at import time.
facts: 2026-07-28 SERVER_REQUESTS is empty (no server-to-client requests at that version)
_adapter() is @cache-memoized to avoid repeated TypeAdapter construction

nodes.name: parse_client_request()
nodes.summary: Validate a client request against its per-version surface type, then parse and return the version-free monolith model.
nodes.signature: def parse_client_request(method, version, params, *, surface=CLIENT_REQUESTS, monolith=MONOLITH_REQUESTS) -> types.Request

nodes.name: serialize_server_result()
nodes.summary: Validate a result dict against the surface type for the given method and version, then dump it with version-appropriate field set (extra fields dropped).
nodes.signature: def serialize_server_result(method, version, data, *, surface=SERVER_RESULTS) -> dict[str, Any]

nodes.name: is_input_required()
nodes.summary: TypeGuard returning True if a result object is an InputRequiredResult (typed or raw wire dict).

nodes.name: parse_server_result()
nodes.summary: Validate a server result dict against its surface type, then parse into the version-free monolith model.
nodes.signature: def parse_server_result(method, version, data, *, surface=SERVER_RESULTS, monolith=MONOLITH_RESULTS) -> types.Result

nodes.name: validate_client_request()
nodes.summary: Validate a client request against the surface only (no monolith parse); raises KeyError for version-gated methods.
nodes.signature: def validate_client_request(method, version, params, *, surface=CLIENT_REQUESTS) -> None

nodes.name: Protocol version registry
nodes.summary: Enumerates every released MCP protocol revision, groups them by handshake vs. modern era, and provides is_version_at_least() for ordering comparisons.
nodes.detail: KNOWN_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS is the master ordered tuple used for all ordering arithmetic. The is_version_at_least() function uses index-based comparison rather than string sorting to stay safe against non-date-shaped future revision identifiers. Unknown version strings return False conservatively. SUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS is kept as a deprecated alias of the full union for v1 compatibility.

nodes.name: is_version_at_least()
nodes.summary: Returns True if version is a known revision at least as new as minimum; unknown versions return False conservatively.
nodes.signature: def is_version_at_least(version: str, minimum: str) -> bool

nodes.name: Wire model base
nodes.summary: Defines WireModel, the shared Pydantic base for all generated surface type classes in _v2025_11_25 and _v2026_07_28.
nodes.detail: WireModel enables populate_by_name=True; each generated subclass sets its own extra ('ignore') in its own ConfigDict. This is the only non-generated file in the _v* namespace boundary.

nodes.name: WireModel
nodes.summary: Base Pydantic model for generated wire types; sets populate_by_name=True; subclasses add extra='ignore'.

nodes.name: Surface types v2025-11-25
nodes.summary: Generated wire-shape Pydantic models for MCP protocol revision 2025-11-25; covers 2024-11-05 through 2025-11-25.
nodes.detail: Generated by scripts/gen_surface_types.py from schema/2025-11-25.json (sha256 4e01628360a2149892eab8f298ceee626d24a58862184eb8ec85d95b8f353e31). Do not edit manually. Each class extends WireModel with extra='ignore' so unknown fields from newer versions are silently dropped during surface validation. Covers all four handshake-era protocol revisions. Contains all schema-exact shapes including JSONRPCResultResponse (the schema name for JSONRPCResponse) and per-method params classes. Approx 3,093 lines.
facts: JSONRPCResponse named JSONRPCResultResponse in this module

nodes.name: Surface types v2026-07-28
nodes.summary: Generated wire-shape Pydantic models for MCP protocol revision 2026-07-28 (the stateless per-request-envelope era).
nodes.detail: Generated by scripts/gen_surface_types.py from schema/2026-07-28.json (sha256 6293cdfe015c14bd36eda4b1331ce37bda377609e58ed6d09d16f28e7d3c7ad4). Do not edit manually. Contains AnyGetPromptResult, AnyReadResourceResult, AnyCallToolResult union aliases used in the SERVER_RESULTS map to allow InputRequiredResult as alternate arms. No ServerRequest union at this version. Approx 3,321 lines.
facts: Introduces AnyGetPromptResult, AnyReadResourceResult, AnyCallToolResult union aliases
No ServerRequest entries (2026-07-28 has no server-to-client requests)

nodes.name: mcp_types public API
nodes.summary: Public API surface for mcp_types: re-exports all names from _types.py, jsonrpc.py, and version.py into one flat namespace via __all__.
nodes.detail: This module imports everything from mcp_types._types, mcp_types.jsonrpc, and mcp_types.version and declares a comprehensive __all__ with 150+ names grouped by category. The __all__ list is the contract: adding a name here is a deliberate API decision. Users import `from mcp_types import Tool` or `import mcp_types as types`.

nodes.name: mcp.types namespace
nodes.summary: Wildcard re-export of mcp_types into the mcp.types namespace for v1 backward compatibility; also binds the jsonrpc, methods, and version submodules as attributes.
nodes.detail: Does `from mcp_types import *` and re-exports __all__. Additionally imports the three mirror submodules (jsonrpc, methods, version) so `mcp.types.version.X` resolves by attribute access as well as import. No logic.

nodes.name: mcp.types.jsonrpc shim
nodes.summary: Wildcard mirror of mcp_types.jsonrpc into the mcp.types.jsonrpc namespace.
nodes.detail: Does `from mcp_types.jsonrpc import *` and re-exports __all__. No new logic. Exists so code that imports `mcp` can write `from mcp.types.jsonrpc import JSONRPCRequest` without taking a direct dependency on the mcp-types distribution.

nodes.name: mcp.types.methods shim
nodes.summary: Wildcard mirror of mcp_types.methods into the mcp.types.methods namespace.
nodes.detail: Does `from mcp_types.methods import *` and re-exports __all__. No new logic. Allows `from mcp.types.methods import parse_client_request` without a direct mcp-types dependency.

nodes.name: mcp.types.version shim
nodes.summary: Wildcard mirror of mcp_types.version into the mcp.types.version namespace.
nodes.detail: Does `from mcp_types.version import *` and re-exports __all__. No new logic. Allows `from mcp.types.version import LATEST_MODERN_VERSION` without a direct mcp-types dependency.

flows.name: Raw JSON-RPC request validated into a typed model
flows.summary: An inbound JSON bytes frame is decoded, the method is looked up in the per-version surface map, validated, and returned as a monolith model.

steps.text: The session layer calls jsonrpc_message_adapter.validate_json() on the raw bytes. The TypeAdapter dispatches on the presence of an 'id' field to pick JSONRPCRequest vs JSONRPCNotification.

The session extracts method and params from the envelope, then calls validate_client_request(method, version, params). A KeyError here means the method is not valid for the negotiated version; pydantic.ValidationError means the params shape is wrong.
If validation passes, parse_client_request() re-runs the surface check and then parses into the monolith row: a concrete CallToolRequest, GetPromptRequest, etc. that the handler receives.
The returned instance is a member of the ClientRequest union. The session dispatches it to the appropriate handler by its method literal.

flows.name: Handler result serialized back to wire format
flows.summary: A monolith result object from a handler is validated and serialized to a version-appropriate wire dict for the JSONRPCResponse envelope.

steps.text: The handler returns a typed result such as CallToolResult or InputRequiredResult. These are members of ServerResult.

serialize_server_result(method, version, result.model_dump()) looks up the surface class for (method, version) in SERVER_RESULTS, re-validates, and dumps with by_alias=True and exclude_none=True. Fields added in later versions are silently dropped by extra='ignore' in the surface class.
The resulting dict is placed into a JSONRPCResponse(jsonrpc='2.0', id=request_id, result=...) and serialized to bytes for the transport.

flows.name: Protocol version negotiation
flows.summary: On connection setup the client and server agree on a protocol version, which is then used as the key for all subsequent method map lookups.

steps.text: The client's offered version string is checked against KNOWN_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS. is_version_at_least() determines whether the client supports the server's minimum requirement.
For handshake-era sessions (through 2025-11-25), the client sends InitializeRequest with protocol_version and capabilities. The server responds with InitializeResult carrying the agreed version.

For the modern era (2026-07-28), the client may send DiscoverRequest first. The server's DiscoverResult carries supported_versions; the client picks one and stamps it on subsequent requests via the _meta PROTOCOL_VERSION_META_KEY.
Once the version is agreed, all method map lookups use (method, negotiated_version). A missing key is a valid version gate: the method is not allowed in this revision.
